summary: Pacific Airport Group filed a Form 6-K announcing the publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The filing contains no M&A, activist, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction. It is a routine ESG disclosure prepared under GRI and SASB standards, covering environmental, social, and governance performance for the 2025 fiscal year. The registrant is a foreign private issuer making an ordinary report under Rule 13a-16. As there is no deal or corporate event, no further analysis is warranted.
